description: This file defines a Qwik component for a sidebar in a notes application. It manages the display of notes, handles creating new notes, and updates the active note state.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: A Qwik component function that renders the sidebar UI, manages note selection and creation.

methods.name: handleNoteClick
methods.description: Handles clicking on a note to set it as active.

methods.name: handleNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new note, adds it to the notes list, and sets it as active.
